metadata.title: Withdraw from a contract
metadata.description: Withdraw from a purchase from SaaSy Land online, and get an acknowledgement of receipt by email.

title: Withdraw from a contract
description: Tell us here that you withdraw from a contract you concluded with SaaSy Land on this website, such as the purchase of a licence. You do not need to give a reason.
rights: Consumers in the EU may withdraw within {days} days of the purchase. For digital content, the right of withdrawal ends once supply begins if you asked for immediate supply and acknowledged that you would lose the right, which you do with the checkbox on Polar’s payment page. Within the same {days} days we also refund a purchase in full before its first use. You can send a withdrawal statement in any case: we check the order and reply. The <refunds>Refund Policy</refunds> explains the details.
account: Signed in? On your <license>licence page</license> your details are already filled in.

form.title: Online withdrawal statement
form.statement: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the purchase identified below.
form.name: Your name
form.emailDescription: We send the acknowledgement of receipt to this address.
form.referenceDescription: The order number at the top of your purchase confirmation email.

receipt.title: We received your withdrawal
receipt.submittedAt: We received your withdrawal statement on {submittedAt}.
receipt.acknowledged: We emailed the acknowledgement of receipt, with this statement and the date and time of its submission, to {email}.
receipt.unacknowledged: We could not email the acknowledgement of receipt yet. We will send it to {email}.
receipt.next: We check the order and reply by email. If the right of withdrawal or our full refund before first use applies, we refund the payment through Polar to the original payment method no later than {days} days after we received your withdrawal, and the licence key stops working.

card.title: Withdrawal

terms.statutoryWithdrawal: You can withdraw from this purchase until {date} without giving a reason, and we refund it in full.
terms.refundable: You asked for immediate supply at checkout, so the right of withdrawal ended when your licence key was issued. You have not used the purchase yet, so a withdrawal until {date} still gets you a full refund under the Refund Policy.
terms.used: You asked for immediate supply at checkout, so the right of withdrawal ended when your licence key was issued, and you first used the purchase on {date}. You can still send a withdrawal statement, and we will reply.
terms.expired: The {days}-day withdrawal period ended on {date}. You can still send a withdrawal statement, and we will reply.

card.received: We received your withdrawal statement on {submittedAt}. We will reply by email.
